verdict.rationale: Operating an equity-management SaaS through natural-language commands, such as an in-app AI assistant or agent interface, is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence only documents conventional click-based workflows: issuing shares, granting EMI options, data rooms, shareholder comms and HRIS integration. The llms.txt file helps LLMs read Vestd's content but does not let users operate the product with natural-language commands, so it earns no credit.
